title: Staff / Sr. Staff Engineer, Data Engineering
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    About the role  
  Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
 Netskope's Data Platform is the backbone behind every security insight our customers see, ingesting and processing security telemetry from a global edge network at massive scale. We own the full data path — from collection at the edge, through stream processing and enrichment, to the query, routing, and delivery systems that put that data in customers' hands. On top of that foundation we build the analytics, reporting, and export capabilities that our customers rely on to understand and act on their security posture. We are now investing in an AI-native future, building a semantic layer that makes our data machine-interpretable and agentic experiences that let customers ask questions of their data in natural language. 
  What you’ll work on  
 
 Partner with architects to design and evolve the systems that carry telemetry from global edge ingestion through processing, query, and customer delivery, with a focus on scale, durability & latency. 
 Raise the bar on observability, SLOs, deployment safety, and production resilience of the platform that others build on top of - not just a single service. 
 Build the AI-native semantic layer that’s the foundation to make our data machine-interpretable, and the agentic experiences on top of it that let customers ask questions in natural language.  
 Lead cross-team initiatives, shaping architecture through design reviews, and mentoring engineers, with the freedom to adopt modern & open source technologies. 
 
  Required skills and experience  
 
 10+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems, with significant time operating at Staff-level (or equivalent) technical scope. 
 Strong coding ability in one or more of Go, Java, Python, or C++, with a track record of shipping production systems, not just designing them. 
 Experience designing for reliability at scale — observability, SLOs, incident response, and safe deployment on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes). 
 Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: influencing architecture decisions, driving design decisions, and aligning teams around a direction. 
 Experience building high-throughput ingestion and data services over modern RPC and wire protocols — HTTP/2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers — including schema design and evolution.  
 Experience with high-throughput data pipelines — data streaming & batch ingestion, processing, and storage using columnar data formats such as Parquet  
 Excellent written and verbal communication, and the flexibility to collaborate across time zones with globally distributed teams.  
 Ability to ramp up quickly into unfamiliar codebases and domains as priorities evo

title: Customer Success Manager (Scaled)
description:

You’ll be responsible for maximizing customer lifetime value and success for a diverse portfolio of thousands of expanding MongoDB customers, acting as a strategic connector between your customers and providing the right help at the right time to achieve their unique business goals. You’ll drive healthy adoption, customer retention, revenue realization, and advocacy at scale. You will innovate, navigate ambiguity, and build scalable programs and processes to deliver real, measurable impact where your customers need it most. 
 We are looking for Mandarin speaking candidates who are based in Hong Kong for our hybrid working model. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Customer Advisory 
 
 Lead and scale effective customer onboarding by leveraging product adoption telemetry to monitor early deployment health, proactively identify and mitigate configuration risks, and guide customers through prescriptive best practices, architectures, and operational strategies that establish a strong technical foundation and accelerate time-to-value and achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 Drive ongoing consumption and value realization through a mix of 1:1 and 1:many engagements (e.g., targeted campaigns, webinars, office hours), using data-driven insights to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across a broad customer portfolio and recommending optimal solutions, features, and adoption paths to achieve customers’ business outcomes with MongoDB 
 
 Account & Portfolio Management 
 
 Own elements of the account plan that drive customer maturity and lifetime value, retention, and revenue realization. Proactively manage thousands of customers across various stages of maturity by leveraging 1-to-many methodologies and tools to balance individual customer impact with scalable outcomes that maximize long-term success 
 Track and report progress against key business outcomes, forecast revenue retention and realization to senior leadership for business predictability, and identify new opportunities to expand customer impact, collaborating with presales teams to support growth 
 Maintain meticulous hygiene in internal systems to ensure a single source of truth for customer insights and accurate territory analysis. Leverage AI-driven tools to streamline daily workflows, improve productivity, and optimize customer success outcomes 
 
 Internal Collaboration & Customer Advocacy 
 
 Amplify the voice of the customer within MongoDB, leveraging customer insights to inform MongoDB’s product roadmap and coordinate across Sales, Product, Services, Support, and Training teams to drive customer health, satisfaction, and value realization 
 Connect customers with the right internal resources, while contributing learnings from customer interactions to strengthen team success and maximize customer value. Contribute to the evolution of scalable programs that enhance efficiency, customer satisfaction, and measurable outcomes 
 
 What You Will Bring 
 
 Relevant Experience: 5 to 7+ years in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., Technical Customer Success, Solutions Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services/Implementation, Technical Account Management) for a deeply technical, ideally consumption-based, product 
 Accountability: 3+ years experience being accountable for customer health and revenue realization across a portfolio of accounts. Experience in managing scaled or pooled portfolios utilizing scalable strategies to enhance customer retention is a plus. Familiarity with designing workflows or engagement strategies using AI or automation-driven tools 
 Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills with the ability to influence technical and business outcomes 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equ

title: Associate Account Director (DTC Outbound)
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.    Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.   The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.   WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 We are seeking a highly strategic, commercially minded, and technically savvy Associate Account Director to oversee a premier portfolio of our most valuable brand-direct accounts. This role is designed for a senior client services professional who thrives on strategic partnership, executional excellence, and solving complex business challenges. The ideal candidate is a trusted advisor who can influence senior stakeholders, drive client success, and identify opportunities to grow long-term partnerships. 
 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING 
 1. Strategic Client Partnership & Executional Excellence 
 
 Executive-Level Advisory: Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior client stakeholders and their partner ecosystem, translating business objectives and market insights into high-impact media strategies that drive measurable outcomes. 
 Strategic Relationship Management: Build and deepen executive-level relationships, confidently navigating complex account dynamics, managing ambiguity, and resolving challenging situations with maturity, sound judgment, and strong negotiation skills. 
 Executional Excellence: Lead flawless campaign execution in a fast-paced environment through exceptional project management, prioritization, and operational rigor, ensuring the highest level of client satisfaction. 
 Platform & Industry Expertise: Maintain deep hands-on expertise across platform capabilities and industry best practices, proactively identifying optimization opportunities and providing strategic recommendations to clients. 
 
 2. Commercial Growth & Portfolio Leadership 
 
 Drive Client Growth: Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts by identifying opportunities for retention, expansion, and increased platform adoption aligned with clients' evolving business objectives. 
 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Business Development, Trading, Measurement, and Product teams to onboard strategic customers, unlock new opportunities, and deliver integrated client solutions. 
 Strategic Account Planning: Develop long-term account strategies that strengthen client partnerships, increase business impact, and position The Trade Desk as a trusted strategic partner.

title: Android BSP Engineer
description:
About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  About the team  
 Stripe Terminal helps Stripe users extend their online presence into the physical world. The Terminal team’s mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has done for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can unlock in-person payments use cases that are right for their business model—whether it’s creating a flagship retail experience, extending their website to a pop-up store, or enabling a mobile point-of-sale at their next event.  
  What we are looking for:  
 As an Android BSP Engineer, you will be responsible for the kernel and driver level system development, which includes building, troubleshooting, and writing automated tests for the Android system on our embedded payments platforms. This team works closely with partner teams throughout the hardware and software product lifecycle, from hardware manufacturing to Android app teams. We also work with external vendors on part selection and initial hardware bring-up. 
  What you’ll do:  
 
 Bring up new devices and lead debugging and performance tuning exercises that span multiple hardware/firmware/software teams. 
 Design, implement, and maintain drivers and Android services that operate efficiently in a constrained environment and meet the reliability and security requirements of the industry. 
 Own the definition of one or more work streams focused on hardware bring-up, peripheral drivers and communication, and power and performance management and optimization. 
 Analyze bug reports and manage the defect resolution process (disposition issues, resolve issues, and report issue status). 
 Interact with global teams with excellent communication skills to provide support information 
 Routinely perform code reviews to ensure high quality designs and implementation 
 Assist in ensuring quality and timeliness of product/feature development. Work closely with QA staff to ensure appropriate test cases are created, maintained, and executed. 
 Proactively solve problems and work independently and within a team environment, with limited guidance. 
 
  Who you are  
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
  Minimum requirements  
 
 2+ years software engineering experience in device driver development, embedded systems, or operating systems 
 2+ years working with mobile or other connected devices 
 Experience using automated testing, build systems, and inter-component communication protocols such as UART, GPIO, SPI, I2C, etc. 
 Proficiency in C/C++ or Kotlin/Java 
 Experience with Android OS, and familiarity with associated software development tools 
 Degree in CS, CE, EE, or equivalent practical experience 
 Experience adding, monitoring and parsing telemetry data to proactively resolve issues 
 Fluency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin Chinese to be able to communicate with our vendors and users/customers 
 
  Preferred qualifications  
 
 Experience with ARM platform 
 Experience working with microcontrollers 
 Knowledge of EMV. 
 Knowledge of cryptography, symmetric, asymmetric, key management and exchange is an asset. 
 Experience with POS Hardware and peripherals. 
 Knowledge and expertise of PCI technology, transaction processing, and related retail standards.

 Degree in CS, EE, or equivalent practical experience.

 Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.  
 The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies  to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.  
 The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development.  We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships. 
 If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.

 Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products. 
 Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.    
 Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.  
 Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products. 
 Negotiate successful contracts. 
 
 What we are looking for in you 
 
 B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer - Linux, PC, IoT

 Experience with the Linux desktop, and related technologies. Ubuntu experience would be a plus

 Comfortable with online communication and collaboration such as mailing lists, Mattermost, wiki

 Strong written and spoken communication skills in English 
 Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team 
 Ability to pick up new technologies and achieve high effectiveness quickly 
 
  What Canonical Offers:  
 
 Learning and development 
 Annual compensation review 
 Recognition rewards 
 Annual leave 
 Priority Pass for travel 
 Annual health check 
 
  About Canonical  
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. title: Staff SDET, AI Gateway
description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope 
 Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs. 
 At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security. 
 Visit  Careers at Netskope  to learn more. Follow us on  LinkedIn  and  Instagram .    Please note, this team is hiring across all levels and candidates are individually assessed and appropriately leveled based upon their skills and experience.  
  About the Role  
  Netskope AI Gateway  helps global enterprises securely adopt and scale Generative AI. We are looking for a  Staff Software Development Engineer in Test  (SDET) to own quality for significant areas of the AI Gateway product, its supporting services, and its APIs, across SaaS and on-prem/hybrid customer environments. 
 This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with real ownership. The areas assigned to you are yours: you set the testing direction and build what is needed to execute it, bringing hard calls to the QE lead as a peer rather than waiting for a specification or a checklist before you act. 
 Depth matters more than volume in this role. We are looking for someone who can get a long way into an ambiguous problem before needing help, go deep when a failure crosses service, infrastructure, and network boundaries, and work directly with developers and product managers to get the underlying problem fixed rather than routed around. 
  What You Will Be Doing  
 
  Own Quality for Your Areas:  For the features and services assigned to you, own the outcome: reliability, correctness, performance, security-related behaviors, and user experience expectations. Decide what needs testing and at which layer, set the bar for shipping that area, and be accountable for what gets through. 
  Turn Ambiguity into a Plan:  Start from partial requirements, an architecture diagram, and a conversation with the developer, and produce a concrete test approach. Surface the risks nobody has written down yet, decide which ones matter, and state clearly what you are choosing not to cover and why. 
  Build the Automation:  Design and implement the automated suites and the frameworks, harnesses, and fixtures behind them. Write them as real software: readable, maintainable, and quick to triage when they fail. Keep flakiness low through deterministic test design, environment isolation, and disciplined use of mocking and service virtualization. 
  Use AI Where It Earns Its Place:  Bring AI and agent-based tooling into the testing workflow: generating scaffolding and test data, navigating unfamiliar code, summarizing logs and failures, and shortening the path from symptom to hypothesis. Be equally clear about the limits. AI-generated tests can look thorough while asserting nothing that matters, so you check what the assertions actually prove. The tool can draft the work, but the coverage decision and the verdict stay yours. 
  Validate the Gateway Data Path:  Verify that AI Gateway stays compatible with the provider APIs it fronts, that policy matches exactly the requests it should, and that the resulting action and logging are correct.

This critical function is part of our mission to transform Linux certification, in partnership with the engineering directors of Ubuntu Enablement and Ubuntu Certification. Our goal is to deliver the world's best long term OS stability commitment on PC, server and IoT hardware. 
 We believe that Engineering Directors should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should be very comfortable reviewing a patch or a software design spec. During the lifespan of an LTS, new kernel improvements will be available to users, and they want to be sure that their hardware will work. Today's Linux certification programs do not meet the needs of its users, and we want to change that.

description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale. 
 The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support). 
 The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

 Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels

 Significant programming experience in Python
